text: Pharmacy Avenue is a major north-south roadway that serves local residents, pedestrians, cyclists, transit users, and motorists travelling through the surrounding neighbourhood. The intersection of Pharmacy Avenue and Stamford Square South/Rosita Crescent has been identified through community consultation as a location where additional traffic control measures are needed to improve safety and support safer crossings. Residents have raised ongoing concerns about vehicle speeds, traffic volumes, and the difficulty pedestrians experience when crossing Pharmacy Avenue at this location. These concerns are especially pressing given the significant number of families, seniors, children, cyclists, transit users, and other vulnerable road users who rely on this intersection to move safely through the community. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Pharmacy Avenue and Stamford Square South/Rosita Crescent.
